items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: And so we worked with, oh, Don Byas (PHONETIC), Ben Webster, Coleman Hawkins used to sit in with us.

ctx.x: So he was just out here with his wife on a visit, and it was a beautiful weekend, you know, because we go back. I think Eddie was 13 when I first met him. Yes, as I was speaking about Eddie, but later on he was taking classical piano in The Loop, during the time when I was going through my different things with guitar and piano around the house, and then Eddie switched over to saxophone. And became a very dominant tenor saxophone player. In fact he was the one that was scouted to take Ben Webster's place with…
